name: Media Runtime Criteria
description: Requires bounded resumable artifact ingestion, asynchronous provider-driven processing, request-fenced cancellation, session-close-fenced streaming, fail-closed ambiguous remote outcomes, conservative provider fallback contracts, cancellation-safe streams, and transfer-framing-independent terminal requests.

criteria.description: The Media Runtime authority guard must pass.

The generic MediaProcessingProvider contract must not treat timeout or network ambiguity as automatic fallback authority. A second provider may be selected only when the failed provider explicitly certifies that failure as fallback-safe.

Production HTTP processing must linearize cancellation against new dispatch, streaming close must fence stale frames, active HTTP work must be cancelled, provider responses must remain bounded, and ambiguous processing timeout/network outcomes must not automatically fail over.

measurement.target: HTTP Media provider cancellation and close fencing

criteria.description: End-of-stream requests may carry a bounded empty body without requiring Content-Length: 0, while ordinary frames remain non-empty and all frame bodies remain size-bounded.
Focused Media Runtime contracts, launcher, and production-provider tests must pass.

acceptanceCriteria.pass: Upload ordering, bounds, checksum, artifacts, jobs, request-fenced cancellation, session-close-fenced streaming, conservative provider fallback semantics, provider routing, terminal frame interoperability, and lifecycle are proven.
acceptanceCriteria.fail: Any artifact, upload, checksum, tenant, provider effect fence, fallback-safety contract, remote-failure classification, job, stream framing, route, or lifecycle proof fails.
acceptanceCriteria.reviewGate: The ghatana-lifecycle Evidence Generator produces canonical Media Runtime evidence; GitHub Actions status is non-scoring provenance only.
